title: AgentResult
description: Body of GET /v1/agent/{job_id}/result once the job is completed: what the agent put in the video. Review's moment list and the phone's duration check come from it. Rules the schema cannot express are in README.

total_s.description: Duration of the video, output seconds. Within 0.5 s of the rendered file and ±10 % of the request's effective_target_s.

title.description: The title the video shows, drawn only from the destination, trip type and start_date.

moments.description: In playback order, one per clip used. Output seconds, the span where the clip is on screen (overlaps from transitions allowed).
